text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What Tokai Teio showed us at the end of 
the year was hope—and at the same time, 
despair.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I am the "Strongest Umamusume" ——Tokai 
Teio!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Until now, I've strived to place the name 
Lois and Lois among the ranks of the 
"strongest." However...
choice_data_list:
You're telling me to make the same kind of 
impact...

You're saying we need to make the same 
kind of impact...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's on a completely different level. No 
matter how much I thought about it, I 
couldn't come up with a single way to 
match that "strongest"...
choice_data_list: Huh? From Lois, LANE...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap, clap!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Invited by Royce and Royce, I came to the 
shrine for Hatsumode.
choice_data_list:
I gotta think of something. Even if I have 
to beg the gods to help me.

I need to think of something. Even if I 
have to beg the gods to help me.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes. Even though I say that, every 
time I remember, my heart... stirs..."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"I'll be reduced to just another 
spectator... What should I do...?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Kyaaaaaah!)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ? What is it?

text_block_list.name: Teio's Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Kyaah, Teio!" "Can I have a handshake~?!" 
"You were so cool in the Arima Kinen!" 
"Tell us your next race! We'll come cheer 
for you!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah-wah, don't push~! It's dangerous, 
seriously, it's dangerous~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ah, Royce!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Sorry! My friends are here, so I gotta 
go!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Man, I'm so glad Royce and the others 
happened to walk by!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Bombarded with handshakes and 
autographs... That was really something, 
wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"I'm happy, but ya know~. My next race 
isn't decided yet. It puts me on the spot 
when people ask me all sorts of things."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You pushed yourself way too hard at the 
Arima Kinen right off the bat, so the 
doctor's ordered you to rest.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Alright, this is where I get off! Thanks a 
bunch, bye-bye!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
The fever pitch is beyond what I imagined. 
It reminds me of Oguri-san's Arima 
Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Our next goal is the Osaka Hai... Teio-san 
won it in the past too, but...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Compared to back then, it feels like it's 
going to lack excitement entirely. 
Compared to that "first comeback drama," 
that is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio has made three comebacks. The 
first was at the Osaka Hai, the year after 
she was injured at the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite it being her first race in nearly 
a year, she lived up to the overwhelming 
favoritism and pulled off a magnificent 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hoofprints far too dazzling... Before 
their brilliance, even reality begins to 
pale...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Truly a radiance that only the strongest 
among the strongest Umamusume can leave 
behind. Yes... something like this is just 
too much...
choice_data_list:
Still, we have to make an impression 
somehow!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Just sitting by and 
twiddling my thumbs won't get me where I 
want to go.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"...I won't give up. Using this brain of 
mine, I'll definitely find a way—!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Even if the path ahead is uncertain, I 
won't stop anymore. I want to show my 
resolve to push forward!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I want to take that first step today. I 
wonder what would be fitting for that 
first step of determination?
choice_data_list: Eat ozoni!

…How about waterfall training or 
something?

If we're talking about something that 
never stops moving, it's a tuna!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
So we're building up our strength with 
ozoni, are we? Hmph, in that case, I 
intend to recharge to my heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Let's eat the ozoni from all 47 
prefectures!
choice_data_list:
Nationwide!? ...Are you making 47 
different kinds?

Nationwide!? ...Are you making 47 
different kinds?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Terrible cost performance and time 
performance. I don't need to do anything 
like that when I already have such a 
strong ally by my side!

text_block_list.name: Royce's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Royce, try this! It's Kagawa-style ozoni 
from my hometown!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
What a lovely aroma of white miso... Oh? 
There's an ocean scent too... It's topped 
with green laver!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the food! ...Mm, this is...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Sweet anko mochi! I'd heard rumors about 
it, but... the sweetness of the red bean 
paste and the saltiness of the white miso 
go together exquisitely!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I've always wanted to try this. Thank you! 
Thanks to you, I got to enjoy authentic 
local flavor!

text_block_list.name: Royce's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who's happy that you took a 
liking to me, Royce-chan!

text_block_list.name: Royce's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Royce, I brought some Kanagawa-style ozoni 
from home! My mom made it for us!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
My! I will be sure to savor Mother's 
heartfelt feelings as well...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Royce and Royce reached out on social 
media, asking fans to bring in regional 
varieties of ozoni.
choice_data_list:
(We can stream and do fan service 
too—killing three birds with one stone!)

(We can stream and do fan service 
too—killing three birds with one stone!)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, thank you, everyone! I love you 
all! Let's have another great year 
together~~~♡

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Waterfall meditation...!? ...That's quite 
a bold suggestion, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I agree! It'll have great impact, so I 
think it's a wonderful idea!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
The waterfall seems to be behind this 
shrine. The head priest told us to wait 
here... Oh?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: It's snowing... No wonder it's so chilly.
choice_data_list: It's way too cold. Let's call it off.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
You're right. In this weather, as 
expected...

text_block_list.name: Worshipper A
text_block_list.text:
Look! That Umamusume's outfit! Isn't she 
doing waterfall meditation!?

text_block_list.name: Worshipper B
text_block_list.text:
You're right! Wait, waterfall training?! 
In this snow?! And isn't that Royce and 
Royce?!

text_block_list.name: Worshipper C
text_block_list.text:
Waterfall meditation in the snow... I can 
really feel your resolve for this year...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once one person noticed, all the shrine 
visitors turned to look at Royce and Royce 
at once. The commotion spread in the blink 
of an eye.
choice_data_list: R-Royce, we have to retreat quickly or—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
No way! If we cancel under these 
circumstances, everyone will call us 
chickens...!
choice_data_list:
However, if you end up ruining your 
health...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I just made up my mind to push through! 
There's no way I can't show some backbone 
here...!
choice_data_list: ...Understood. In that case...
...Alright, then.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer-san, what are you doing?
choice_data_list: Yaaaaaah!
Taaaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
That's absurd!! With a human body... Are 
you alright!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As her Trainer, I stepped up to show 
resolve on her behalf. That midwinter 
trial turned into a valuable experience 
for the both of us.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...Well, I get what you're trying to say. 
Taking inspiration from a tuna that never 
stops swimming, right?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Since it's New Year's, let's 
go watch the first tuna auction of the 
year!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, reservations to observe the first 
auction had already closed. So, we decided 
to head to a market near the port instead.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it seems they're inspecting the 
horses before the auction. It's quite a 
friendly, harmonious atmosphere.
choice_data_list:
Everyone's having such a nice, friendly 
chat.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ――Ah, looks like the auction is starting.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: —Huh? The mood suddenly...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Wait, it's already been sold!? Huh, what? 
Hold on, things are moving way too fast!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: I can't hear a single word!
choice_data_list: Yeah, they're so... experienced at this!
Yeah, it's almost too... natural!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
T-That was some incredible jockeying for 
position...! I couldn't let my guard down 
for even a single second!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Quoting prices at that speed and deciding 
whether to raise or fold in an instant... 
that's how it works, right?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
What high-level technique... If you're 
going to push forward without retreat, 
you've gotta be sharp and brisk like that!
